plugins.description: DSH × Blender 直连插件（v3.1.0-alpha.1，GUI 优先，无头备用）：6 个模型工具让 AI 直接驱动 Blender——blender_session（会话/归属/权限/事务）、blender_op（catalog 与 loop/opt/preset）、blender_py（GUI 会话内 Python）、blender_see（视口截图与序列）、blender_run（唯一作业入口：render/headless/队列）、blender_inspect（commands/cmd）；Gateway 单一端点、addon 反向连接，Windows virtual-gui GA、Linux preview，34 family / 228 op 的契约层（catalog / 判定 / 验收 / 造型 / 装配 / 白模 / 导出）。v3.0.0 为工程重构版（runtime TypeScript、extension zip）；v2.6.2 新增曲面算法包 surface_*（loft/sweep/patch → tessellate → validate → export，M0–M2/M4；M3 fit 与 M5 blend/offset 未实现）。P0–P2 能力（现由上述 6 工具承载）：参考图量具（img_digest/probe/measure/calib）、装配扫描/清单/合并/修复/门/导出（asm_*）、白模与 Seedance 参考包（blockout refsheet/turntable）、同机位 QC（visualreport_report）、无头轮廓拟合（shapesolve_solve）、缺陷注入评估（eval_run）、强制门（gate_/deliver_export require_gate）。默认先开 GUI；无头备用；装完必须重启 DSH；唯一验收判据 doctor kind=ok；blender-modeling skill 随包自动注册。详见 README 与 docs/操作教程.md。

description.en: Deep PTC builds on official PTC with interruptible jobs, selectable shells and a conversation-side panel. Click output files to open them; drag the panel edge to resize it, and place the capsule below the composer, in its toolbar or nowhere. Sounds and a desktop notice for waiting cards (adjustable volume, your own audio uploadable and trimmable), cards in DSH Go, and a virtual DSH the model can use itself. description.en: A visible agent browser for DSH: drives the vendored ego-compatible Chromium over CDP, can attach to a running Chrome/Edge/Brave, and can route through egolite, Tabbit or Lightpanda; 34 structured bcdp_* tools, with only bcdp_status resident by default; realtime watch panel with direct input, and non-CDP channels sync frames by 3s polling.
description.de: Sichtbarer Agent-Browser für DSH: steuert das mitgelieferte ego-konforme Chromium über CDP, kann einen laufenden Chrome/Edge/Brave anbinden oder über egolite, Tabbit und Lightpanda routen; 34 strukturierte bcdp_*-Tools, von denen standardmäßig nur bcdp_status resident bleibt; Echtzeit-Beobachtungspanel mit Direkteingabe; Nicht-CDP-Kanäle gleichen Frames im 3-Sekunden-Takt.
description.es: Navegador agent visible para DSH: maneja el Chromium ego-compatible vendido via CDP, puede conectarse a un Chrome/Edge/Brave en marcha y enrutar por egolite, Tabbit o Lightpanda; 34 herramientas bcdp_* estructuradas, con solo bcdp_status activo por defecto; panel de observación en tiempo real con entrada directa, y los canales no-CDP sincronizan fotogramas por sondeo de 3 s.
description.fr: Navigateur agent visible dans DSH : pilote le Chromium ego-compatible vendu via CDP, peut se connecter à un Chrome/Edge/Brave en cours d'exécution ou passer par egolite, Tabbit et Lightpanda ; 34 outils bcdp_* structurés, seul bcdp_status reste résident par défaut ; panneau d'observation en temps réel avec saisie directe ; les canaux non-CDP synchronisent les images toutes les 3 s.
description.it: Browser agent visible per DSH: gestisce il Chromium ego-compatible vendato via CDP, puo collegarsi a un Chrome/Edge/Brave in运行 o instradare tramite egolite, Tabbit o Lightpanda; 34 tool bcdp_* strutturati, con solo bcdp_status activo por defecto; pannello di osservazione in tempo reale con input diretto, e i canali non-CDP sincronizzano i frame con polling di 3 s.
description.ja: 表示可能な agent ブラウザ（DSH）：同梱された ego 対応 Chromium を CDP で操作し、実行中の Chrome/Edge/Brave にも接続でき、egolite・Tabbit・Lightpanda 経由も使用できる。34 の構造化 bcdp_* ツール、既定で常駐は bcdp_status だけ。リアルタイム監視パネルはクリック・スクロール・IME 直接入力に対応し、非 CDP 経路は 3 秒ポーリングで映像を同期する。
description.ko: DSH용 화면에 보이는 에이전트 브라우저: 동봉된 ego 호환 Chromium을 CDP로 조작하고, 실행 중인 Chrome/Edge/Brave에 연결하거나 egolite·Tabbit·Lightpanda 경로도 쓸 수 있다. 34개의 구조화된 bcdp_* 도구, 기본값에서는 bcdp_status 하나만 상주한다. 실시간 관찰 패널은 클릭·스크롤·IME 직접 입력을 지원하고, 비CDP 경로는 3초 폴링으로 화면을 동기화한다.
description.pt: Um navegador de agente visível para o DSH: controla o Chromium compatível com ego embarcado no pacote através de CDP, pode se conectar a um Chrome/Edge/Brave em execução e rotear por egolite, Tabbit ou Lightpanda; 34 ferramentas bcdp_* estruturadas, com apenas a bcdp_status residente por padrão; painel de observação em tempo real com entrada direta, e os canais não-CDP sincronizam quadros por sondagem a cada 3 s.
description.ru: Видимый agent-браузер для DSH: управляет ego-совместимым Chromium через CDP, может подключаться к запущенному Chrome/Edge/Brave и может работать через egolite, Tabbit или Lightpanda; 34 инструментов bcdp_*, по умолчанию живёт только bcdp_status; панель осмотра в реальном времени с прямой подачей; не-CDP каналы получают кадр по 3-секундному опросу.
description.zh: DSH 的可见 agent 浏览器：经 CDP 驱动内置 ego 兼容 Chromium，可挂接运行中的 Chrome/Edge/Brave，或走 egolite、Tabbit、Lightpanda 通道；34 个 bcdp_* 结构化工具，默认只有 bcdp_status 常驻；实时观察面板支持直接输入，非 CDP 通道按 3 秒轮询同步画面。

description.en: Archives the earliest conversation context into memory/ folders as *pending* entries (no model call during archiving; since v1.4.1 every archive brings the context below compress.releaseTargetPercent); the next request's system prompt gets a memory-scoring task section and the current session model submits α, trust β, keywords and an optional event label through the memory_judge tool in its own context — unscored memories are not recalled. Later matching memories are recalled by keyword (including bidirectional matching) with α as a deterministic priority (FAIR-DRI fair lanes: a query-matched high-α memory surfaces in the same round, low-α memories get a bounded worst-case latency and are never discarded) plus optional time / event constraints, with a per-memory β usage preamble; when the context exceeds the threshold again the oldest recalled entries are removed from the injected block and marked for re-review (no new folders are created). Restarts restore a recall-state v3 snapshot of the recalled block. Disabling the plugin row unregisters the tools, the prompt sections and every listener; config.json enabled=false is an activation-time switch (reloading the plugin is required to re-enable it). Since v1.3.0 it also supports two QQ channels (dsh-onebot-qq and Derpyu520/qq-bridge): automatic detection, one memory folder per stable chat key, an α floor for recalls triggered by non-owner group members, a reversible auto-patch of the Derpyu tool whitelist and a heuristic-scoring fallback. Since v1.4.2 a memory_group_recall tool lets a QQ private-chat owner query group-chat memories read-only (private→group only; group chats, non-owners, WebUI and subagents are rejected; private/WebUI memories are never returned; the owner identity is checked against compat.ownerIds and the tool is fail-closed when it is empty). Since v1.4.3 the scoring summary, the re-review body and the group-chat snippets render archived QQ tool-result JSON as readable sender：text conversation lines instead of raw field names.
description.zh: 上下文超过阈值时，把最早的一段对话以“待评分”状态归档到 memory/ 回忆文件夹（归档不调用模型，v1.4.1 起每次归档至少把上下文压到 compress.releaseTargetPercent 以下）；下一次请求的 system prompt 出现“记忆评分任务”，由当前会话模型结合当前语境调用 memory_judge 工具提交 α、β、关键词与可选事件标签，未评分的记忆不参与回忆。之后按关键词（含双向匹配）、α 的确定性优先级（FAIR-DRI 公平车道：查询命中的高 α 首轮必现，低 α 有界最迟召回、不被丢弃）以及可选的时间/事件约束自动回忆，注入块带 β 使用规则；上下文再次超限时最旧的回忆会从注入块移除并置为待复核（不新建文件夹）。重启后已注入的回忆块按 recall-state v3 快照原样恢复。在 DSH 中禁用插件行后工具、prompt sections 与监听器立即卸载；config.json 的 enabled=false 是启动时开关（改回 true 需重载插件）。兼容 dsh-onebot-qq 与 Derpyu520/qq-bridge 两个 QQ 渠道：自动检测、按会话 chat 键归并记忆、非主人群成员 α 门控、可回滚的 Derpyu 工具白名单自动补丁与启发式评分降级。v1.4.2 起另增 memory_group_recall：QQ 私聊主人可只读查询群聊历史记忆（私聊→群聊允许，群聊/非主人/WebUI/子代理拒绝；只读、不返回私聊与 WebUI 记忆；主人身份由 compat.ownerIds 校验、为空时工具拒绝）。v1.4.3 起评分摘要、待复核原文与群聊摘要按模型可读文本渲染：QQ 工具结果的原始 JSON 显示为 sender：text 对话行而不是字段名。

description.en: Worktree Space: one task, one space — work on parallel tracks. Put a task that spans one or more Git repositories into its own task space: every repository involved gets a worktree on the same task branch, and the task space registers itself as a workspace where agent sessions work on their own. Multiple tasks move forward in parallel without interfering with one another; when the work is done, merge back into each repository's target branch and clean up the worktree branches and task spaces as needed. Report problems at https://github.com/kangtsang/dsh-worktree-space/issues
description.zh: Worktree Space：一任务一空间，工作多路并行。把一个或多个 Git 仓库的工作任务放进独立任务空间：每个参与的仓库在同一个任务分支上各开一个 worktree，任务空间自动注册为工作区，agent 会话就在其中独立工作。多个任务并行推进、互不干扰；结束后合并回各仓库目标分支，worktree 分支和任务空间按需清理。遇到问题请在 https://github.com/kangtsang/dsh-worktree-space/issues 反馈。

description.en: Reports leftover dsh-auth-* entries in the desktop client's cookie store, ships a command that purges them once the client is fully closed, and adds a panel that checks and repairs the profile patch structure.

description.ru: Отчитывается об остатках dsh-auth-* в хранилище cookie десктопного клиента, поставляет команду очистки после полного выхода из клиента и добавляет панель проверки и исправления структуры патча профиля.
description.zh: 只读播报桌面客户端 cookie 库里残留的 dsh-auth-* 本地登录凭据，随包分发「客户端完全退出后」可执行的清理命令；并提供 profile patch 的结构化体检与一键修复面板。

description.en: One-tap connect SenseNova Token Plan language and image models into DSH (off by default), with image recognition and thinking level filled in automatically. On a rate limit it backs off and retries on its own instead of misreading it as an exhausted quota. Xiaohuanxiong can also be signed in by QR code, bringing in its models and their consumption multipliers, and taking over DSH web search.

description.en: Chinese metaphysics (xuanxue) — twenty-two systems in one plugin: eight chart systems plus fourteen quick references and self-assessments (almanac, solar–lunar conversion, date selection, bone-weight fortune, Xiao Liu Ren, horoscope, numerology, MBTI-style 16-type questionnaire, life-curve, feng shui, name analysis, nine-type TCM body-constitution questionnaire, five-movements-six-qi yearly chart, Taiyi Shenshu with accumulated-year ju, palace, eight gates and Wen Chang). The first screen shows 20 pick-of-the-bunch entries in three groups and folds the rest behind 'N more'; all 22 stay in the flat tab view. Chart systems: BaZi (hidden stems, ten gods, 12 stages, 42 shensha, strength, pattern and useful-god, luck scoring), Zi Wei Dou Shu (49 stars with brightness, four 12-god cycles, 34 patterns, decade and annual/monthly/daily/hourly mutagen), LiuYao, MeiHua YiShu, Da Liu Ren, Qi Men Dun Jia (three ju-selection schools), compatibility charts (BaZi and Zi Wei), and Tarot, plus an ask-driven interpretation layer. Computed locally with networking off by default, exposed as an agent tool with a Web panel.

description.en: Cross-session todos for DeepSeek Harness whose central rule is that an agent's "done" is not completion. Whether the agent reports it from a tool or the host infers it when a dispatched conversation ends cleanly, the record waits in Needs review: a person confirms it, or it goes back to the list. One JSON file you own, written by both sides, with created time, description, attached documents and links, a plan of steps and the sentence it came from; hand an item to a conversation in one click and read back what that conversation last said.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话待办清单，中心规则是：Agent 说「做完了」不算完成。它自己在工具里报完成，或交给的会话干净收尾后宿主自动收尾，两条路都只进「待确认」，人点头才算完成、退回就回清单。一份属于你的 JSON 文件，人和 Agent 读写同一条记录：加入时间、描述、文档与地址、步骤计划、原话；一键交给某个对话继续干，随时回读那边最后说了什么。

title.zh: 门禁 · 目录访问管制

description.en: Access gate for directories: adds a '门禁' entry right below 'Skills' in the app-level nav row (official sidebar.panellist seat, order 6), diffs the managed roster (D:\.agents\门禁-名单.txt — one managed object per line: a top-level directory name under D:\ or any absolute path) against the disk, toggles each object between three levels (deny / read / full), and persists the state to D:\.agents\门禁-授权.json for agents and tools to read. Paths match by longest path-segment prefix; a missing or corrupt roster makes the gate deny everything (fail-closed). Roster edits only land after the owner presses the button in the panel, and the file is backed up first.
description.zh: 门禁 · 目录访问管制：在导航排「技能」正下方加一个「门禁」入口（官方 sidebar.panellist 槽位，order 6），把受管名单（D:\.agents\门禁-名单.txt —— 一行一个受管对象，D 根一级目录【名字】或【任意绝对路径】）与磁盘比对并标出差异，逐个受管对象切换三级授权（禁 / 只读 / 可读写删），状态持久化到 D:\.agents\门禁-授权.json 供 agent / 工具侧读取；路径按「路径段最长前缀」命中，名单读不到时一律拒绝；名单增删只在界面里给出差异、由户主点击后落盘（改前先备份到回收站）。

description.en: Skill center: adds a nav row (official sidebar.panellist slot, order 5, between Plugins and Scheduled tasks) listing every skill this machine actually exposes (all six skill-root kinds, not just ~/.dsh/skills), explaining why a skill is invisible (dropped:* / root-missing / disabled), and toggling a single skill by renaming only its entry file (SKILL.md -> SKILL.md.disabled). Read-only for project-level roots.
description.zh: 技能中心：在导航栏加一页（官方 sidebar.panellist 槽位，order 5，位于「插件」与「自动化任务」之间），列出本机实际暴露的全部技能（六类技能根，不只是 ~/.dsh/skills），说明某技能为何不可见（dropped:* / 根缺失 / 已禁用），并可通过只改入口文件名（SKILL.md → SKILL.md.disabled）单独启停一个技能；项目级技能根只读。

description.en: Always-on coordinator for DeepSeek Harness: talk to Dorothy in her dedicated panel to manage workspaces, dispatch and verify tasks across sessions, handle routine approvals and questions, and get concise reports.
description.de: Eine stets aktive Koordinatorin: Sprich mit Dorothy in ihrem eigenen Panel – sie öffnet Arbeitsbereiche, startet Sitzungen, verfolgt deren Fortschritt, klärt Genehmigungen und Fragen für dich und meldet sich zurück.
description.es: Una coordinadora siempre disponible: habla con Dorothy en su propio panel y ella abrirá espacios de trabajo, iniciará sesiones, seguirá su progreso, resolverá aprobaciones y preguntas por ti y te informará de vuelta.
description.fr: Une coordinatrice toujours active : échangez avec Dorothy dans son propre panneau ; elle ouvre des espaces de travail, lance des sessions, suit leur avancement, gère pour vous les approbations et questions, puis vous fait un retour.
description.ja: DeepSeek Harness 常駐コーディネーター「ドロシー」：専用パネルで話しかけるだけで、ワークスペース管理、セッション横断のタスク実行・検証、定型的な承認や質問への対応、簡潔な結果報告まで一貫して担います。
description.pt: Uma coordenadora sempre ativa: converse com a Dorothy no painel dela, e ela abre espaços de trabalho, inicia sessões, acompanha o progresso, resolve aprovações e perguntas para você e reporta de volta.
description.ru: Постоянный координатор: общайтесь с Дороти на её панели — она открывает рабочие области, запускает сеансы, отслеживает их ход, решает вопросы и утверждения за вас и отчитывается о результате.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 常驻调度管家：在专属面板里直接交代需求，她会替你管理工作区、跨会话分派并核验任务、代管常规审批与提问，并向你简明汇报。

description.en: Turn any subject problem or concept into a single-file interactive courseware HTML: solid/analytic geometry, chemistry reactions in 3D, step-by-step tutorials, 2D/3D physics, plane geometry and science visualization — 8 subject skills, zero API keys.
description.zh: 把学科题目/知识点生成为单文件交互课件 HTML：立体几何/解析几何/化学反应 3D/化学教程/物理 2D·3D/平面几何/科普可视化，8 个学科技能，零 API 密钥。

plugins.name: dsh-model-switch
plugins.title: dsh-model-switch
plugins.description: DSH plugin: choose models for subagents and plan execution separately / 为子代理和计划执行选择更合适的模型
plugins.author: lincong

description.en: A real browser in the right sidebar that the agent drives: browser_open, browser_snapshot (accessibility tree plus a screenshot), browser_click (by ref or CSS selector, hit-tested), browser_scroll (scrolls to trigger lazy loading), browser_hover (moves the pointer so stacked controls fan out), browser_zoom (scales the page so a desktop layout fits the narrow sidebar), browser_screenshot (stitches a long page into one PNG under the workspace screenshots/ folder), browser_type, browser_press, browser_eval, browser_download (attachments land in the workspace downloads/ folder with a sha256). Pages are fitted to the panel width after they load, so one screen shows as much as it can. Open the panel from the right sidebar guide entry "Browser (agent)". The badge shows who is driving (agent / you / busy). Press "Take over" to drive it yourself; input tools are refused until you press "Hand back". Human verification pages are detected and paused for you, never bypassed.
description.zh: 在右侧栏里放一个真浏览器，由 Agent 用 browser_open、browser_snapshot（无障碍树 + 截图）、browser_click（ref 或 CSS selector，带命中测试）、browser_scroll（滚动触发懒加载）、browser_hover（悬停展开叠卡）、browser_zoom（缩放页面，桌面站才塞得进窄侧栏）、browser_screenshot（长页拼接成整页 PNG 存到工作区 screenshots/）、browser_type、browser_press、browser_eval、browser_download 十一个工具操作（附件可下到工作区 downloads/，带 sha256）。打开页面后自动按面板宽度适配缩放，一屏尽量看全。从右侧栏引导页的「浏览器（Agent）」打开面板。徽章显示当前是谁在操作；点「我来接管」自己操作，接管期间输入类工具会被拒绝，点「交还 Agent」恢复。检测到人机验证时会自动停下等你处理，绝不代替你过验证。

description.en: MCP hub for 1C development: active only in selected projects (.dsh-1c.json or the projects list). There EDT is connected up front, while BSL Language Server (diagnostics, types, navigation), standards and a task tracker are mounted on demand via edt_pin; in a git worktree (including dsh-git-worktree) the plugin raises its own EDT workspace under build/<branch> (its name is shown in the EDT window title) with plain text and form screenshots. 1C rules enter the prompt only there.
description.ru: Хаб MCP-серверов для разработки на 1С: включается только в выбранных проектах (файл .dsh-1c.json или список projects). В них EDT подключён сразу, BSL Language Server (диагностика, типы, навигация), стандарты и система задач — по требованию через edt_pin; в git worktree (в т.ч. dsh-git-worktree) плагин поднимает отдельный EDT workspace в build/<ветка> (имя каталога видно в заголовке окна EDT) с plain text и скриншотами форм. Правила 1С появляются в промпте только там.

description.en: Keeps long coding-agent sessions lean: wrap a stretch of work in a named task, and when it ends, fold that whole span into one short titled summary. The conversation stays readable, context costs stay low, and any fold's original content can be read back on demand. Built for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 长会话不再越滚越重：把一段工作用命名任务包起来，任务结束后，这段对话就折叠成一条带标题的摘要。读起来始终清爽，上下文占用一直很小，折叠掉的原文也能随时按需回读。为 DeepSeek Harness 打造。

title.zh: 鱼社 · 大肥鱼虚拟养成系统

description.zh: 点几下就能养一条自己的大肥鱼：可视化引导一键上手，她陪你聊天、替你干活、按自己的性格去 B站学习长大，每天写日记汇报，还会写信、拍照片回来给你看。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-academic-writing
plugins.title: dsh-plugin-academic-writing
plugins.description: Academic writing toolkit for DeepSeek Harness agents: paper outlines, title/abstract skeletons, GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA citations and reference lists, LaTeX snippets, structure checks, term glossaries, phrasing QA, and a pre-submission checklist

plugins.name: dsh-vps-manager
plugins.title: dsh-vps-manager

plugins.name: @a9i5k4/dsh-literature
plugins.title: @a9i5k4/dsh-literature
plugins.description: DSH Literature 文献侧窗：在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏识别 DOI/arXiv/标题、抓取元数据与全文、写入本地文献库或导出目录，并提供内置 PDF 阅读器（缩放/翻页/目录/搜索/高亮/笔记）。

plugins.name: dsh-pdf-reader
plugins.title: dsh-pdf-reader
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: content-aware PDF reading tools for vision models (pdf_scan / pdf_read_page / pdf_render_region). Detects figures (vector+raster), tables, math, and two-column layout per page, then routes text pages to extraction and figure/table/math pages to high-DPI region crops rendered for read_image — avoiding DeepSeek's ~800x800 whole-page token ceiling. Backed by PyMuPDF; returns a clear warning (with the exact install command) when Python or a dependency is missing.

plugins.name: dsh-session-clean
plugins.title: dsh-session-clean
plugins.description: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏会话补上官方缺失的「删除会话」：运行中置灰、二次确认、真正删除（列表、登记与磁盘数据一并清除，做不到时如实告知）；侧栏底部另有「清理分组」面板，可批量清空整组会话或清空并移除分组。Adds the missing per-session Delete action and a workspace cleanup panel to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.
plugins.author: Ansellwan

plugins.name: dsh-skin-mahoyo
plugins.title: dsh-skin-mahoyo
plugins.description: 《魔法使之夜》(Witch on the Holy Night) 主题的 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 整屏皮肤 —— 原作 UI 复刻、三角色立绘与表情切换、昼夜两套 BGM、人格 skill、片尾彩蛋
plugins.author: AvalonskyAfar

plugins.name: dsh-cc-agents
plugins.title: dsh-cc-agents
plugins.description: Load Claude Code .claude/agents (identity-anchored subagents: frontmatter + system-prompt body) into DSH delegation via the persona channel.

plugins.name: dsh-cc-ecosystem
plugins.title: dsh-cc-ecosystem
plugins.description: One-install bundle for the whole dsh-cc ecosystem: pulls in dsh-cc-loader plus the six Claude Code adapters (skills, permissions, agents, hooks, mcp, memory) and mounts all of them in one profile layer.

plugins.name: dsh-cc-hooks
plugins.title: dsh-cc-hooks
plugins.description: Run unmodified Claude Code hooks in DSH with per-session discovery: project .claude/hooks + global ~/.claude/hooks + plugin dirs. All five handler types execute (command/http/mcp_tool/prompt/agent) through @deepseek-ai/dsh-hook-protocol (21/31 wired events, if-field filtering, official event×type support matrix). Breaks the official bridge's process-level single-config limit.

plugins.name: dsh-cc-loader
plugins.title: dsh-cc-loader
plugins.description: Shared parse layer for the dsh-cc ecosystem: parses Claude Code .claude/ (project + global) into a standalone .dsh intermediate representation (IR), classifying every component DIRECT/ADAPTED/UNSUPPORTED/BLOCKED and filtering unsupported ones out.

plugins.name: dsh-cc-mcp
plugins.title: dsh-cc-mcp
plugins.description: Load Claude Code MCP server configs (.mcp.json / plugin.json inline mcpServers) into DSH as runtime-registered tools: project-root .mcp.json → mcp__<server>__<tool>, plugin MCP → mcp__plugin_<name>_<server>__<tool> (official CC naming). Client bridge on the official @modelcontextprotocol/sdk — no config-row writes, zero-write path preserved. Ships the /mcp management panel (status, reconnect, tool list, persisted enable/disable) as a client half.

plugins.name: dsh-cc-memory
plugins.title: dsh-cc-memory
plugins.description: Load Claude Code's auto-memory (MEMORY.md index + ~/.claude/projects/<slug>/memory/*.md) into DSH as a per-request system-prompt section, with two runtime switches: off entirely, or read-only vs read-write memory tools. Ships the /cc-memory switch panel as a client half. Discovery, index budgeting and truncation follow the Claude Code CLI.

plugins.name: dsh-cc-permissions
plugins.title: dsh-cc-permissions
plugins.description: Enforce Claude Code permission rules (.claude/settings.json allow/deny/ask, deny>ask>allow) in DSH via a tools/pre-execute gate; CC allow rules auto-answer the approval/request seam (incl. sandbox escalation). Reads CC settings as a read-only source; DSH-side approvals never write back to .claude.

plugins.name: dsh-cc-skills
plugins.title: dsh-cc-skills
plugins.description: Load Claude Code .claude/ skills, commands and rules (project + global ~/.claude) into DSH. Fork of dsh-claude-compat (MIT) by biedongbin.

Falls back to the replay splice on hosts without the projection API. The append-only session log is never rewritten.

plugins.title: dsh-pet-indesktop
plugins.description: 给 DSH 网页界面加一只叫「大肥鱼」（昵称「鲸鲸」）的桌宠，八种配色皮肤随时切换，并且有性格：只吃米饭、聪明但懒、嘴硬心软；被连点几次会躺平，被叫「大肥鱼」会生气并坚持自己不胖，叫「鲸鲸」才高兴；她记仇也记好——今天被叫胖三次就冷淡，被叫昵称三次就亲近；离开半小时再回来她会嘴硬地说「才不是等你」；头几次见面她怕生；十分钟没人理就游去角落（只改视觉，不改你放她的位置）。A desktop pet called "Big Fat Fish" (nickname Jingjing) for the DSH web GUI, with eight switchable colour skins and a personality: she eats rice, is clever but lazy, and is a tsundere. Rapid clicks make her lie down and refuse to react; calling her fat annoys her and she insists she is not; the nickname 鲸鲸 pleases her. She keeps count both ways - three fat-calls today and she greets you cold, three nickname-calls and she greets you warm; come back after half an hour and she greets you with "I was not waiting for you"; the first few meetings she is shy; ten quiet minutes and she drifts to a corner, visually only, never moving the position you chose. The eight images are PNGs bundled with the plugin and served by the plugin itself.

description.en: Shows one ghost follow-up prompt in an empty, editable composer after an agent turn finishes normally in the active session. Automatically yields to Plan Mode, composer blocks, inline quotes/references, and popups. Sends at most one bounded background model request per completed turn using recent conversation text only (no full history or raw tool output), writes nothing to the session log, and stops all requests and key handling when disabled in Plugins.

description.de: Text in einer abgeschlossenen Assistant-Antwort auswählen, in einem unabhängigen Eingabefenster nachfragen und in einem echten Session-Zweig weiterarbeiten. Farbige Markierungen, Zweigbaum, Bühne und einklappbare Seitenleisten-Gruppe. Zweige sind echte Sessions; gesendete Zweige können nur archiviert werden.
description.es: Selecciona texto en una respuesta completa del assistant, pregunta en una ventana de entrada independiente y continúa en una rama de Session real. Incluye marcas de color, árbol de ramas, escenario y un grupo plegable en la barra lateral. Las ramas son Sessions reales; las ramas enviadas solo se pueden archivar.
description.fr: Sélectionnez du texte dans une réponse finalisée de l’assistant, posez votre question dans une fenêtre de saisie indépendante et continuez dans une branche de Session réelle. Marques colorées, arbre des branches, scène et groupe repliable dans la barre latérale. Les branches sont de vraies Sessions ; les branches envoyées ne peuvent être qu’archivées.
description.ja: 完了した assistant の回答内のテキストを選択し、独立した入力ウィンドウで質問して、実際の Session ブランチとして続けられます。色付きマーク、ブランチツリー、ステージ表示、折りたたみ可能な左サイドバーのグループに対応。ブランチは実際の Session で、送信済みのブランチはアーカイブのみ可能です。
description.pt: Selecione texto em uma resposta concluída do assistant, pergunte em uma janela de entrada independente e continue em um ramo de Session real. Marcas coloridas, árvore de ramos, palco e grupo recolhível na barra lateral. Os ramos são Sessions reais; ramos enviados só podem ser arquivados.
description.ru: Выделите текст в завершённом ответе assistant, задайте вопрос в отдельном окне ввода и продолжите в настоящей ветке Session. Цветные метки, дерево веток, сцена и сворачиваемая группа в боковой панели. Ветки — это реальные Sessions; отправленные ветки можно только архивировать.
description.zh: 在已完成的 assistant 回答中划选文字，弹出独立输入浮窗，在真实 Session 分支中继续追问；支持彩色标记、分支树、舞台放大和左侧栏折叠。分支是真实 Session；已发送分支只能归档，继承前缀对模型可见、在 UI 中隐藏。

plugins.name: dsh-set-model
plugins.title: dsh-set-model
plugins.description: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: through the TypeSafe Jev decision model (it reads each turn's instruction, classifies the task and picks a preset) or through its own tool calls, the agent switches model presets and thinking depth on its own, following the task at hand. Includes set_model / list_models agent tools, preset mode with switch_preset / list_presets, presets that declare reasoning effort only so one model can retune its own thinking depth, a configurable stage-to-preset prompt, plan-mode auto-transition, provider whitelist and context-window guards, active-model runtime context injection, and a bundled Web settings page. 为 DSH 提供的插件：通过 TypeSafe Jev 决策模型（每轮读取指令、判断任务类型并选出档位）或调模工具调用，让 Agent 根据任务场景自主切换模型预设和思考深度。含 set_model / list_models 自主调模工具、switch_preset / list_presets 档位切换、只声明思考强度即可在同一模型上调节思考深度的档位、可配置的「阶段→档位」提示词、Plan 模式自动升降级、Provider 白名单与上下文窗口护栏、活跃模型运行时上下文注入，以及插件自带设置页。
plugins.author: johnnren

plugins.name: dsh-simulated-life
plugins.title: dsh-simulated-life
plugins.description: Simulated life context for DeepSeek Harness: injects the past 24h of simulated life events from the workspace .life/ directory into every conversation turn with session-level deduplication, and ships the life_react tool so the agent records its feelings, thoughts and actions back into its life log. dsh-simulated-life：为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 提供拟真生活上下文——每轮自动注入工作区 .life/ 目录近 24 小时的生活事件（会话内智能增量去重），并提供 life_react 工具让 Agent 主动沉淀对事件的感受、思考与行动，形成可反哺世界演化的持久生活日志。
plugins.author: johnnren

description.en: dsh-rust-exec: a resident Rust worker handles command execution, sha256-guarded file IO, code indexing and search, session-log projection and resource sampling; the host stays a thin JSON-RPC, lane-scheduling, 8-route layer and exposes 11 tools (10 rust_* plus native_help). The UI adds a pinned-header projection view with fuzzy filtering and a fixed 420 px detail pane, a Grafana-style monitor, and the dsh-rust-exec resource strip.
description.zh: dsh-rust-exec：常驻 Rust worker 承担命令执行、sha256 校验的文件读写、代码索引与检索、会话日志投影与资源采样；宿主只做 JSON-RPC 管道、lane 调度与 8 条 HTTP 路由，对外 11 个工具（10 个 rust_* 加 native_help）。界面提供固定头部的会话投影视图（模糊筛选、固定 420px 详情）、Grafana 风格监控器和 dsh-rust-exec 资源状态条。

description.en: Patch-style file editing for DSH: one apply_patch tool accepting git/unified diff (default) and Codex apply_patch syntax (opt-in), applied all-or-nothing against verified file content, with read-before-write intent, sandbox-aware delete/move, and an optional dry-run check.
description.de: Dateieditierung im Patch-Format für DSH: ein einziges apply_patch-Werkzeug, das git/unified-Diff standardmäßig annimmt (Codex-apply_patch-Syntax optional), ganz oder gar nicht angewendet, nachdem der Dateiinhalt geprüft wurde; liest vor dem Schreiben, löscht und verschiebt mit Sandboxbewusstsein, und kann vorher eine dryRun-Prüfung ausführen.
description.es: Edición de archivos por patch para DSH: un solo tool apply_patch que acepta el diff git/unified por defecto y la sintaxis Codex apply_patch opcional, aplicada en todo o nada contra el contenido verificado del archivo, con intención de lectura antes de escritura, borrado/movimiento consciente de la sandbox, y comprobación dry-run opcional.
description.fr: Édition de fichiers par patch pour DSH : un seul outil apply_patch qui accepte le diff git/unified par défaut et la syntaxe Codex apply_patch en option ; appliqué en bloc ou pas du tout, après vérification du contenu du fichier ; lit avant d'écrire, supprime et déplace en tenant compte de la sandbox, et peut d'abord faire un contrôle dry-run.
description.it: Editing a patch per DSH: un solo tool apply_patch che accetta il diff git/unified per default e la sintassi Codex apply_patch come opzione; applicato in tutto o in niente, dopo la verifica del contenuto del file; legge prima di scrivere, cancella e sposta tenendo conto della sandbox, e può prima fare un controllo dry-run.
description.ja: DSH 用のパッチ式ファイル編集：単一の apply_patch ツールが既定で git/unified diff を受け入れ、任意で Codex apply_patch 構文も選べる。固まり全体を一度だけ適用し、現在のファイル内容と照合してから書き込む。読込前置の意図、サンドボックス配慮の削除・移動、任意の dry-run 事前検査を備える。
description.ko: DSH용 패치식 파일 편집: apply_patch 도구 하나가 기본으로 git·unified diff를 받고, 고르면 Codex apply_patch 문법도 쓸 수 있다. 묶음 전체를 한 번에만 적용하고, 현재 파일 내용과 대조한 뒤에 기록한다. 읽기 우선 의도와 샌드박스 배려 삭제·이동, 임의의 dry-run 사전 검사를 갖춘다.
description.ru: Редактирование файлов по patch для DSH: один tool apply_patch принимает git/unified diff по умолчанию и syntax Codex apply_patch по выбору, применяется целиком или ничего против проверенного содержимого файла; читает перед записью; delete/move учитывает sandbox; может сначала сделать dry-run проверку.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供补丁式文件编辑：单个 apply_patch 工具，默认接受 git/unified diff，另可选 Codex apply_patch 语法；整块应用，先按当前文件内容校验再写入，含读后写意图、沙箱感知的删除与移动，以及可选的 dry-run 预检。

plugins.name: @jipika/dsh-memory
plugins.title: @jipika/dsh-memory
plugins.description: Progressive long-term memory for DSH: sharded markdown bodies under ~/.dsh/memory/topics/, with only a live-generated map (shard · keywords · count · latest date) injected into the system prompt, entries pulled on demand via grep + read — so the prompt cost stays flat however large the memory grows. Two layers (global + per-project) plus the global rule files, viewable AND editable in DSH Settings, with per-layer switches and an index/full injection toggle. v0.5.0 adds enforcement hooks: a write guard on the native tool pipeline (format/secrets/history rules, optional external command judge, deny/ask with reasons fed back to the model), post-write audit log, a read reminder when memory files are read, a mandatory discipline block, and an optional injection filter command. Zero extra LLM cost, live re-read. v0.5.1 keeps the switches in ~/.dsh/memory/settings.json — read live by the plugin and edited from the settings pane over the plugin's own route, independent of the host settings API. v0.6.0 fixes the index silently degrading to a title-less directory once memory outgrew the hardcoded 9k budget (which is why an agent could see memory injected and still never read it): the index now shrinks per-shard along a newest-N-per-shard ladder under a configurable indexBudget, adds per-shard keywords (routing hint) and latest-entry dates, ships a 'check memory before starting a task' discipline, and makes full mode read the shard bodies (auto-falling back to index when over budget) instead of the retired memory.md navigation file. v0.7.0 makes 'map' the default injection mode (shard-level map only, no entry titles): retrieval = grep the memory dir with task keywords, then read the matched line; layers with <=12 entries stay inlined; the discipline block teaches that two-step path and routes cross-shard lookups (>=3 entries / >=2 shards / >=3k body) to a subagent that returns facts + line numbers instead of raw bodies. v0.9.0 adds the card-memory layer for roleplay sessions and makes every path Windows-safe: home resolution follows os.homedir() (so an undefined or empty HOME no longer roots paths at the drive root), tool and bash paths are normalized before guard matching, and drive-letter cwds produce valid project slugs. v0.9.2 fixes retrieval ranking at scale (IDF-weighted entry scores, df=0 CJK bigram fragments excluded from the coverage gate, BM25-style length normalization, preview windows anchored on the rarest matched token instead of a fixed 240-char head cut; measured locally: shards covered per top-8 2.88->5.75, largest tie block 4.38->1.13, previews containing a matched token 67%->100%): shard-level bonuses no longer inflate every entry in that shard (they were added inside the entry loop, so all hits from one shard shared an identical score and ordering collapsed to date-then-line), a per-shard quota stops one shard from filling the whole result page, and the default scope is the current project layer (other projects' shards — 60% of the pool locally — are skipped but reported in dropped.offScopeLayers/offScopeFiles, with scope:'all' to opt back in). v0.9.3 stops query function words from being searched at all (a CJK stopword set plus Latin stopwords, judged per-token so a real word that merely contains a stopword character stays searchable) and rejects sub-2-character queries, which previously collapsed into an unfiltered whole-library substring match: on the local corpus 'the/of/...'-style Chinese stopword-only queries went from 1270 hits to 0, and a single-character query from 1459 hits to a clean rejection, while the 15-query positive suite kept 14/15 recall with per-query hit counts unchanged (ranking, IDF, length normalization, per-shard quota and preview anchoring are untouched). v0.9.4 adds the mapless injection mode: the global shard map stops living in the system prompt entirely (locally measured: 188 shards = 40364 chars injected every turn) and is replaced by a fixed 370-char pointer, while shard-level routing moves into the memory_search reply as a query-scored top-8 bridge. Measured on 10 real tasks from this machine: entry-level retrieval alone finds the right shard in 6/10, the bridge in 10/10 (the 4 tasks entries miss, the bridge returns at rank #1) because a task phrased in Chinese colloquial prose cannot literally match an English shard name, and bridge scoring only needs topic-level overlap. Injection size becomes independent of memory growth and no longer invalidates the KV prefix when a memory is written. Bridge cost averages 1378 chars and only pays on turns that actually search. Also consolidates the inject-mode whitelist, which was the same ternary chain copy-pasted in three places (host 1 + client 2), into normalizeInjectMode()/INJECT_MODES plus a probe assertion that both tables agree, and keeps the per-shard over-limit warning in the bridge because the map that used to carry it is gone.

description.en: Configure reusable role templates in the Web UI so the lead agent can launch native DSH teammates on demand for different tasks. Each role defines its own duty prompt, model, thinking effort, tool whitelist, and skills; during execution, the lead agent can communicate continuously with teammates while you inspect their logs, summaries, and request details at any time.
description.zh: 在 Web 界面集中配置可复用的角色模板，并由主代理按任务需要启动对应的 DSH 原生团队成员协同工作。每个角色可独立设定职责提示词、模型、思考强度、工具白名单与技能；任务执行期间主代理可与成员持续通信，用户也能随时查看各成员的运行日志、执行摘要与请求详情。

description.en: Turn useful conversations into a knowledge base you can revisit. Start a discussion with /cardex and end it with /cardex end; a model organizes the questions and answers into Markdown cards, a knowledge tree, and an offline graph. Related discussions can add to existing cards, with links back to the original questions and answers, so your knowledge keeps growing and stays easy to browse.
description.zh: 把对话中值得保留的讨论整理成自己的知识库。在会话中输入 /cardex 开始讨论，结束时用 /cardex end 让模型把问答整理成 Markdown 知识卡片、知识树和离线图谱。相关讨论可以补充到已有卡片，并保留原始问答的回链，方便日后按分类浏览、查找，让知识随着每次讨论慢慢积累。

description.en: Switch sessions between Standard and Fast tiers via the model selector or `/fast` command, attaching the `priority` tier to eligible Responses requests and forwarding them to the target endpoint when Fast is enabled. Interactive sessions can toggle tiers on the fly while team roles lock in their tier at launch; once Fast is active alongside required configuration and upstream support, requests are routed with `priority`, with actual speed and billing governed by your provider.
description.zh: 通过模型选择器或 `/fast` 命令在会话中按需切换 Standard 与 Fast 档位，在开启 Fast 时为符合配置的 Responses 请求附带 `priority` 档位并转发至目标端点。交互会话支持随时切换，团队角色则在启动时锁定所用档位；启用 Fast 且完成前置配置与上游接口支持时请求即按 `priority` 档位发送，实际响应速度与计费规则由上游服务商决定。

description.en: Send one-way session notifications to Feishu direct messages or group chats via a custom app so you can keep track of key checkpoints while away from your desk. It pushes alerts for approval requests, questions, and plan confirmations, allows the model to actively send a completion summary when overall work lasting at least three minutes wraps up, and supports custom recipients along with Do Not Disturb time windows and timezones.
description.en-us: Send one-way session notifications to Feishu direct messages or group chats via a custom app so you can keep track of key checkpoints while away from your desk. It pushes alerts for approval requests, questions, and plan confirmations, allows the model to actively send a completion summary when overall work lasting at least three minutes wraps up, and supports custom recipients along with Do Not Disturb time windows and timezones.
description.zh-cn: 通过飞书自建应用向私聊或群聊发送单向会话提醒，在离席时及时同步关键节点。插件会在出现审批请求、提问和计划确认时即时推送消息；当整体工作持续满 3 分钟进入完成或收尾阶段时，模型可主动调用工具发送完成摘要，并支持按需配置接收对象、免打扰时段与时区。
description.zh: 通过飞书自建应用向私聊或群聊发送单向会话提醒，在离席时及时同步关键节点。插件会在出现审批请求、提问和计划确认时即时推送消息；当整体工作持续满 3 分钟进入完成或收尾阶段时，模型可主动调用工具发送完成摘要，并支持按需配置接收对象、免打扰时段与时区。

description.en: Aggregate pinned sessions that are currently rendered and visible across workspaces into a single sidebar view, saving you from digging through separate workspaces. The aggregated section can either stay above the workspace list with independent scrolling or scroll inline with the list, directly reusing native session rows, status indicators, and actions while respecting current folding and search filters without forcibly expanding hidden items.
description.zh: 将当前原生视图中已渲染可见的各工作区置顶会话汇总到侧栏同一处，省去跨工作区来回翻找。汇总区可固定在工作区列表上方独立滚动，也可并入列表内随整体一起滚动；条目直接复用原生会话行、状态标识与快捷操作，并严格遵循当前视图范围，被折叠或搜索过滤隐藏的会话保持原状不强制展开。

description.en: Package and order plugin tools and prompts to reduce first-turn token usage and keep fixed content more stable for cache reuse. In supported PTC sessions, selected plugins initially show only a description and tool directory; the model retrieves full tool definitions when needed, with related prompts loaded according to your settings. You can also reorder prompts by source, remove content you do not need, and separate fixed content from changing state. Install the plugins you want and load infrequently used tools on demand instead of filling the context on every request.
description.en-us: Package and order plugin tools and prompts to reduce first-turn token usage and keep fixed content more stable for cache reuse. In supported PTC sessions, selected plugins initially show only a description and tool directory; the model retrieves full tool definitions when needed, with related prompts loaded according to your settings. You can also reorder prompts by source, remove content you do not need, and separate fixed content from changing state. Install the plugins you want and load infrequently used tools on demand instead of filling the context on every request.
description.zh-cn: 通过对插件的工具和提示词按需打包、排序，减少首轮 token 占用，让固定内容更稳定，方便复用缓存。在支持的 PTC 会话中，选中的插件首轮只展示简介和工具目录，模型用到时再获取完整工具定义，并按设置加载相关提示词。你还可以按来源调整提示词的顺序，移除不需要的内容，把固定内容和动态状态分开。这样就能放心安装想用的插件，让不常用的工具按需加载，不必每次都占用上下文。
description.zh: 通过对插件的工具和提示词按需打包、排序，减少首轮 token 占用，让固定内容更稳定，方便复用缓存。在支持的 PTC 会话中，选中的插件首轮只展示简介和工具目录，模型用到时再获取完整工具定义，并按设置加载相关提示词。你还可以按来源调整提示词的顺序，移除不需要的内容，把固定内容和动态状态分开。这样就能放心安装想用的插件，让不常用的工具按需加载，不必每次都占用上下文。

description.en: Code-generated Chinese videos: script, edge-tts narration, measured timeline, deterministic frame rendering, ffmpeg encoding, sample-level mixing and automated QA. Covers promos, report-to-video, narration with subtitles, and A/V sync fixes.

description.en: Searches and fetches the web through the DeepSeek Search and Fetch APIs, backing web_search and web_fetch.
description.zh: 通过 DeepSeek Search / Fetch API 为 web_search 与 web_fetch 提供检索后端。

description.en: Send native Markdown Slack notifications, reply in threads, read channel & thread history, upload files, add reactions, run online diagnostics, and optionally receive messages via Socket Mode.

description.en: Install all 18 standalone DSH plugins for email, calendar, memory, media, and developer workflows, with unified Suite updates and in-place hot reload.
description.zh: 一次安装全部 18 个独立 DSH 插件（覆盖邮件、日历、记忆、媒体与开发工具），支持整包统一更新与原地热重载。

plugins.name: dsh-voice-assistant
plugins.title: dsh-voice-assistant
plugins.description: Voice assistant plugin for dsh web: hands-free wake phrase, dictation, voice edit commands, and Chinese TTS.

description.en: “Can you help me?” is like “I don't feel well” — the plugin turns it into a complete prompt.
description.zh: 「那你能帮帮我吗？」你只管这么问，像病人说「我不舒服」，插件就会替你补全提示词。

description.en: Embeds a configurable web chat URL with one-click DeepSeek / Doubao platform presets (URL plus dedicated DOM selectors switch together, so the auto-loop and auto-pilot keep working) and two-way bridges desktop conversations with the web chat: three chat entries, an optional auto-loop (web reply → desktop draft only), and a full auto-pilot channel that extracts a delimited review block, auto-submits the next turn via official conversation.send and pauses on a native Modal decision card you control (centered overlay, dimmed backdrop, question and options generated from the intercepted content, with a continue-and-re-push entry). The status bar stays fixed; bind a session for trigger mode, start auto-pilot for full-auto, stop auto-pilot to fully halt, and switch back to semi-auto in one click reusing the binding. Full auto-pilot flow passed initial real-machine verification and is being refined.
description.zh: 把可自定义的网页聊天 URL 嵌入 DSH（一键切换 DeepSeek / 豆包平台预设，URL 与专用 DOM 选择器整包联动，自动闭环与全自动通道继续可用）并双向桥接桌面会话与网页聊天：三个聊天入口、可选的自动闭环（网页回复只写桌面草稿）、以及全自动投递通道——只提炼网页定界区块、经官方 conversation.send 自动提交下一轮，命中完成/重启/验收/重复/错误/最大轮数即弹原生 Modal 决策卡（居中浮窗、遮罩变暗、问题与选项按拦截内容实时生成、带继续并补推入口）由你掌控；状态条常驻固定显示；点「绑定当前会话」开启条件触发，点「启动全自动」切全自动，「停止全自动」彻底停机，「切回半自动」复用现有绑定一步回到条件触发。全自动流程初步真机验证通过，正在不断完善中。

plugins.name: dsh-linghun-memory
plugins.title: dsh-linghun-memory
plugins.description: 灵魂（Linghun）记忆体方案（DSH 插件）——v0.4.0 定位回归：memory 回归记忆定位、收口者回到 linghun 侧（不再注入身份/判断 section，只注册记忆 section soul:linghun-memory）。成本硬伤简化：记忆体依赖未发布的公共包会断安装/评测链路，发布期改为自包含——海马体以 vendor/hippocampus.js 副本打入发布包（开发期真源为三方共享单例 dsh-hippocampus，scripts/sync-vendor.mjs 同步），零 npm 依赖、零审核等待、评测钉版不受影响。LoCoMo-Plus 全量 401 题（m401v4 程序化索引画像）acc 92.52%（371/401，+17.21pp），闭卷基线 75.31%、开卷 94.76%，画像成本归零（87%→0）只比开卷低 2.24pp。核心能力：记忆完全本体化（事件/事实/规则三型→三本体）、暖态/冷储/情景、目标系统 goal.js（16/16 满分）、人物画像层（六槽）、本体资源池、记忆地图、ACC 主动模式。不是人设卡，是记忆体。
plugins.author: syyr1987

description.en: Connects QwenWork (千问办公) to DSH: reads the locally signed-in session, runs a loopback OpenAI-compatible bridge, and translates DSH model requests into QwenWork's ACP conversation protocol. The session is recovered from the desktop app or browser cookie store, with a pasted Cookie header as a fallback.
description.zh: 把千问办公（QwenWork）接入 DSH：读取本机已登录的会话，在本机回环起一个 OpenAI 兼容桥，把 DSH 的模型请求翻译成千问办公的 ACP 对话协议。支持从桌面客户端与浏览器的 Cookie 库自动恢复登录态，也可手填 Cookie 兜底。

description.zh: 对没有任何其他恢复层接手的模型请求持续重试，采用有上限的指数退避，并提供实时设置面板。

description.en: Guards DeepSeek Harness streamed output against repetition: when the same string repeats up to the threshold (10 by default; Simple mode offers Strict 10 / Balanced 15 / Loose 30 presets) it opens a decision card while output keeps streaming; stop now, or allow this call to continue; without action it stops only after the repeats reach threshold x multiplier and the minimum reaction time has passed, and commits the partial answer. The card shows repeat progress and the reaction-time countdown; after Allow, a follow-up asks whether to whitelist the repeated text (also available from the recent-records viewer). Local providers are not force-stopped by default; an optional pause-display mode holds the hit chunk. Fenced, inline and indented code share one relaxed threshold; repeat counts can follow unit length through a piecewise table or a JS module; settings and derived values are written back automatically. Stop notices include an optional continue instruction and an opt-in browser system notification; optional JSONL stops / allows / fillers logs are visible in the settings-page recent-records viewer (three sections collapsed by default; click to expand), with opt-in full content (redacted by default, risk confirmation). Logs include schema/event IDs, bad-line diagnostics and one-click clearing. Optional reasoning filler-word alert: only configured strings are checked by occurrences per 1k chars, and it suggests compressing the context or starting a new session without stopping output; alerts and dismissal/replacement outcomes can be written to fillers.jsonl. Verified on DSH 0.2.2-rc.5 (Node >= 24.9), host API >= 0.1.1.
description.zh: 实时截停 DSH 流式输出里的复读：同一字符串连续重复达到阈值（默认 10 次；简单模式提供严格 10 / 平衡 15 / 宽松 30 预设）即弹出决策卡片（输出继续），可立即截停或允许继续；不操作时达到「阈值 × 倍数」且过最短反应时间才自动截停，已生成内容照常提交为助手消息。卡片显示当前重复进度与反应时间倒计时；允许继续成功后可追问是否把本次重复文本加入白名单（也可从最近记录查看）。本地模型默认不强制截停；可选「命中时暂停显示」；围栏 / 行内 / 缩进代码统一按「阈值 × 倍数」放宽；次数可按单元长度用分段表或 JS 模块决定；白名单、检测窗口与表格模式派生的单元长度自动写回设置，改完无需重启。截停后可弹全局通知（可选继续指令）与可选的浏览器系统通知；可记录 stops / allows / fillers JSONL，设置页查看最近记录（三组默认收起，点击展开）并可按需开启完整内容（默认脱敏，需风险确认）。日志支持坏行诊断、事件关联与一键清空；可选思维链填充词提醒：只检测列表中的字符串，按次/千字符统计并在超过阈值时建议压缩上下文或新开会话，不截停输出；提醒事件与关闭/取代结果可写入 fillers.jsonl。已在 DSH 0.2.2-rc.5（Node ≥ 24.9）实测，宿主 API ≥ 0.1.1。
